records.issue_text: assert-null-then-fail pattern in reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey swallows AssertionError via catch(Exception), so the negative assertion for absence of the webauthn form is dead code and the test passes even if the webauthn form is wrongly rendered
records.rationale: In `reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey`, the code catches `Exception` (e.g., `} catch (Exception nsee) { // expected }`). `MatcherAssert.assertThat(...)` fails by throwing `AssertionError`, which is an `Error` (not an `Exception`) and therefore is **not** swallowed by this catch. If the webauthn form is present, `assertThat(driver.findElement(...), nullValue())` will throw `AssertionError` and the test will fail, so the negative assertion is not dead code.
